patterns.note: Full-bleed hero video that occupies the entire viewport, with subsequent content sections scrolling over it.
Extremely large, bold sans-serif headings are used for key statements, creating a strong visual hierarchy against smaller, legible body text.
A minimalist palette of stark black and light gray (#f4f4f4) dominates, allowing product imagery and the hero video to provide natural color accents.
Sections reveal with a subtle fade-in and slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth, guided scrolling experience.
The hero video background remains fixed or subtly parallaxes as the initial text and subsequent content scroll over it, creating depth.
Content is presented in distinct, generously spaced sections, often featuring asymmetrical layouts with large images or video alongside text blocks.

technique_notes: The site uses a scroll-triggered animation system (likely locomotive-scroll based on hints) to reveal content. Sections appear to fade in and slide up from the bottom as they become visible in the viewport, creating a dynamic flow.

The hero section features a full-bleed video background that remains in place or subtly parallaxes during the initial scroll, while overlaying text and subsequent content sections scroll smoothly over it.
The primary navigation bar is initially transparent over the hero video but becomes sticky at the top of the viewport and gains a solid background after the user scrolls past the hero section.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif hero text (~5-6x body) with large, bold headings (~2-3x body) and smaller, uppercase labels, all against a clean body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; input fields and buttons have a slight curve, while overall layout elements maintain sharp corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with significant vertical whitespace between major sections, creating a sense of openness and premium feel, balanced with tighter spacing in feature grids.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its immersive, full-bleed video hero that acts as a persistent background for the initial scroll, with text and subsequent content sections scrolling seamlessly over it. This creates a highly dynamic and engaging introduction, setting a premium and editorial tone that elevates the product beyond a typical marketing page.
